title: Anthropic’s Mega-IPO Plan Looms Over Packed US Listing Calendar

summary:
Anthropic PBC’s IPO is casting a long shadow over companies’ US listing plans, as they try to find room for their deals to grab attention after the Sept. 7 Labor Day holiday.

The Claude developer is preparing to file publicly for an initial public offering that’s expected to raise as much as SpaceX’s record $86.2 billion debut, if not more, in the coming weeks. Some firms and their backers are finding it hard to get the attention of long-term-oriented investors and sovereign wealth funds when the prospect of an Anthropic IPO is imminent, according to people familiar with the preparations.

For a closer look, we speak with Bailey Lipschultz, Senior Equities Reporter for Bloomberg News. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Sweden Officially Signs Contract for New Frigates From France
title_cn: 瑞典正式签署法国新护卫舰合同
summary: Sweden officially signed a €4.3 billion ($5 billion) contract with France for Naval Group SA to supply four frigates to the Nordic state as it seeks to increase maritime defenses and take a more active role in NATO operations at sea.

title: Modi Urges ‘Friend’ Putin to End War in Ukraine at Summit Talks
title_cn: 莫迪在峰会上敦促“朋友”普京结束乌克兰战争
summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi called on President Vladimir Putin to end Russia’s war in Ukraine during a meeting on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in Kyrgyzstan.

title: Mina de Brasil es clave en estrategia de tierras raras de EE.UU.
title_cn: 巴西矿对美国稀土战略至关重要
summary: Una mina de tierras raras en Brasil expone los obstáculos que enfrenta EE.UU. para reducir su dependencia de China, desde dificultades de producción y procesamiento hasta riesgos políticos y vacíos en la cadena de suministro.

title: Europe Presses Spain and Greece to Give Ukraine Air Defenses
title_cn: 欧洲敦促西班牙和希腊向乌克兰提供防空系统
summary: NATO and European Union countries are pressuring Spain and Greece to hand Ukraine Patriot interceptor missiles as Kyiv struggles to repel Russia’s mounting air strikes.

title: Iceland to Hold Off From EU Accession Talks as Voters Say No
title_cn: 冰岛因选民拒绝而推迟加入欧盟谈判
summary: Iceland’s government pledged to honor the result of Saturday’s tight and divisive referendum, where voters concerned about control over fisheries narrowly turned down reopening membership talks with the European Union.
